product.title: Palm Springs Indian Canyons Bike and Hike

description.text: Explore the Indian Canyons area on a guided bike-and-hike adventure from Palm Springs. This active outing combines cycling and short guided walking segments through canyon landscapes, desert scenery, and native palm oasis terrain while your guide manages route pacing and logistics.

highlights: Guided bike-and-hike format in the Indian Canyons area near Palm Springs
Combines cycling segments with on-foot trail exploration
Focus on canyon landscapes, desert scenery, and native palm oasis settings
